description: Assign one Site Health finding to a teammate or set its work status: todo, in_progress, ready_to_verify, or dismissed (not an issue, which stays closed even when a later audit finds it again). Pass the page's finding_id and task_revision from the issue list or the issue pages read as finding_id and revision; a revision that is no longer current, or a finding that has since recurred, is refused with 409, so re-read first. unassign true (or assignee_user_id null) clears the assignee; the teammate must have analytics access on the website. A newly assigned teammate is emailed. Returns the new revision with the before and after assignee and status. Signed-in connections only: an API key has no teammate to act as, so API-key connections are not offered this tool and a direct call is refused with 403. Requires Site Health on the website's plan; otherwise the call fails with 403.

assignee_user_id.description: A teammate with analytics access on the website, as get_user_by_email or an earlier assignee.id gives it; null clears the assignee (chat tools send unassign true instead).

finding_id.description: The finding, as `finding_id` names it on an affected page.

revision.description: The page's `task_revision` from the same read; a stale value is refused.

unassign.description: true clears the assignee. Chat tools must use this: a null assignee_user_id is dropped as unspecified. Cannot be sent with an assignee_user_id.

work_status.description: todo, in_progress, ready_to_verify or dismissed (not an issue).

name: update_site_health_task
